<section class="article-section">

        <h2>The Drifter Manifesto</h2>
        <p style="margin-bottom: 2rem; font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--text-dark);">
          The Drifter Manifesto is a comprehensive series that establishes the theoretical foundation 
          for understanding biomechanical systems through the lens of control-affine dynamics. This 
          series derives the mathematical framework, introduces key concepts like drift/input decomposition, 
          and provides the notation and methodology used throughout all AffineDrift research.
        </p>
        
        <div class="article-card">
          <h3><a href="articles/theory-part1.html">Theory Part 1 &mdash; State definition and affine derivation</a></h3>
          <p>Establishes the multibody coordinates, derives the control-affine structure, and sets the notation used in every subsequent article.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="article-card">
          <h3><a href="articles/theory-part2.html">Theory Part 2 &mdash; Drift/input decomposition, ZTCF, ZVCF</a></h3>
          <p>Formalizes how to separate passive dynamics from deliberate torque using zero torque and zero velocity counterfactuals.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="article-card">
          <h3><a href="articles/theory-part3.html">Theory Part 3 &mdash; Drift invariance and taxonomy</a></h3>
          <p>Explores invariants, introduces a force taxonomy, and discusses limitations of the affine assumption.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="article-card">
          <h3><a href="articles/theory-part4.html">Theory Part 4 &mdash; Modal Approximation, Wrenches, and Pendulum Dynamics</a></h3>
          <p>Collects derivations, modal approximations, and pendulum examples that support the main theory.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="article-card">
          <h3><a href="articles/theory-part5.html">Theory Part 5 &mdash; Simulink Model Documentation</a></h3>
          <p>Documents the Simulink implementation, numerical routines, and supporting technical notes.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
